comment: The Apple Health stale rule shared by the app (deriveHealthConnectionState in lib/features/health/health_models.dart) and the Coach watch-outs (watch_outs.ts): elapsed time since the last successful sync is more than 2 days. Both test suites read these cases.

cases.name: exactly two days is not stale
one second over two days is stale
a sync just after midnight is stale two days and a minute later, though the dates differ by two
a sync late in the evening is not stale 47 hours later, though the dates differ by two
a sync three days ago is stale
a sync this morning is not stale
